description: Show your own allowance: plan, daily limit, lookups used today, how many remain, when it resets (00:00 UTC) and any credit balance. Free and never counted as a lookup. Limits: 30 anonymous MCP calls a day, 50 with a free API key from https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/start (an email address, no payment).
name: get_usage

outputSchema.description: Your plan, daily allowance and what is left today.

counted.description: Always false: this call is not counted.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

identity.description: Who is counted: kind (key or anonymous) and counted_as.

suspended.description: true when the key is suspended.

title: Show my daily allowance
